text:
Nora: heads-up: discovered weird per-tenant cost swing in the dashboard — prefetch shows large negative hour for tenant `greymatter`
Ibrahim: can you paste the panel link? is this the new "per-model SKU" breakdown view?
Nora: yes -> /console/costs/greymatter -> Prefetch credits (by SKU). hour 03:00 shows -$950 then normalizes
Sophie: could be sampling mismatches. we sample router events at 1% but sidecar does 5%. dedupe heuristics assume uniform sampling which is false
ingest-bot: Ingest schema v3 deployed to canary (event fields: emitter_id, sample_rate, model_sku, quant_profile)
Rogelio: ingestion change is great — but we need an immutable trace_id on events to reliably dedupe across emitters. currently orig_id is optional
Tess: UX quick-win: add a small "Est." badge and clamp visual floor to 0; also show "confidence: low/med/high" based on sampling variance
Vik: +1 on clamp. also add a tenant-level toggle "Show estimations" so PMs can present raw audited numbers for billing
Ibrahim: for long-term: propose we compute a dedupe_confidence metric per-tenant per-hour using overlapping sample probabilities. formula sketch: 1 - P(duplicate) where P approximated from sample_rate router/sidecar overlap
Sophie: can you share the formula in thread? makes it easier to validate
Ibrahim: sure: `P_overlap ≈ sample_r_router * sample_r_sidecar`, `dedupe_confidence ≈ 1 - min(1, alpha * P_overlap)` where alpha tuned from live replays
Rogelio: we'll need a nightly job that replays full logs for high-impact tenants to calibrate alpha and surface bias corrections in the dashboard
Nora: timeline: Tess will ship the clamp and badge as a hotfix before tomorrow's demo. ingestion/trace_id work on a phased rollout next sprint
Tess: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/12901 — clamps values, new confidence pill, toggle behind feature flag `prefetch_estimates_v2`
ingest-bot: Schema migration scheduled: v3 -> v4 emitters rollout window 2025-03-12..2025-03-14
Sophie: follow-ups: (1) add `model_sku` tag to econ events so cost panel can break down savings by SKU; (2) add `quant_profile` so we can show quantization impact on per-token cost
Vik: also consider exposing an "estimated unit cost" line per-SKU using cached KV stats. helps explain when a cheap quantized SKU dominates savings
Ibrahim: ops alert suggestion: create rule `prefetch_fraction > 0.5 AND dedupe_confidence < 0.4` -> auto-tag + attach replay link. That should surface noisy attribution quickly
Rogelio: implementation detail: dedupe_confidence computed in streaming job then stored as field on hour-rollup rows so dashboard queries are cheap
Nora: final: Tess to patch UI today, Sophie+Rogelio to schedule emitter trace_id + model_sku in next sprint, Ibrahim to prototype confidence calc using last month's logs
Tess: will post canary metrics here after deploy and add small demo note for sales
Nora: thanks team. if the clamp hides an underlying billing issue we'll escalate to #incidents
